purpose: Provider-neutral media generation capabilities for SCENTAI content production. Providers create drafts/renders only; publishing remains outside this layer.

limitations: Requires local access to repository product assets and ffmpeg/Pillow.
Current ChatGPT GitHub connector cannot execute this local toolchain or upload binary outputs directly.

providers.integration_rule: Provider-specific credentials and tokens must never be stored in repository state.

global_gates: Provider output never changes fragrance claims or product relationships.
Provider output must use the approved SCENTAI script and tracked content_id.
Generated or altered bottle visuals must not materially misrepresent the real product.
Final media must pass SCENTAI technical QA before content review.
No provider is authorized to publish to social platforms automatically.
Explicit user approval is required before any publish/upload action.
